title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. Name Meaning Inquiry 2912 views Q. Assalaam alai kum, I am expecting my first baby by july and we would request your guidance in selecting the names. We have selected names for both boy / girl baby. Pls advice Boy - Syed Salman Farsi / Syed Rayyan / Syed Zohair Girl - Sumairaa Asim / Fariha Asim / simrah asim. Shukriya . Allah hafiz! 2238 views Q. Asak Mufti Saheb, Thanks a lot for answering my question.Fatwa Id 10582,(Fatwa: 124/125=D/1429).You replied that :"You may keep any of the two names: Ahmad or Muhammad".I am sorry but the response is a bit unclear to me.Does that mean that Ahmed or Mohammad can be either first or the last name.If,they can also be the last name or middle names,Can I keep my son's first name after any other name?Like:Ayaan Ahmed or Ayaan Mohammad .I just want to make sure that "Ahmed or Mohammad" can be the last names or not?Can I keep the first name of my child by any other 99 names of Prophet Mohammad(P.B.U.H) as well? I would relly appreciate your response. Thanks for your patience. 3916 views Q. I selected name of my daughter as Khansa after discussing an Alim namely Qari Jameel Ahmed Ziayee but now some Ulama are criticizing and saying for changing name. Respected Mufti sb tell what should I do? 2950 views Q. Respected pious scholar,Is my name kaynat shamsi fine or should change my name? 1574 views Q. Islamic Names 4859 views Q. My brother's full name is AHMAD AL MUHAIMIN (nick name MUHAIMIN). 2711 views Q. Assalamu Alaikum, Dear Brother, My name is Naseer and I am working in Dubai. I am sending this question on behalf of my friend. My friend name is Shakeel Ahmed. He has blessed with 3 son as of now. The names of his first two sons are 1). Faizan Muhammed & 2). Muhammed Farhaan. His third son name is Muhammed Subhan and his age is 2 years. The question is that, is it okay to put name as Muhammed Subhan for any muslim child? Recently he was advised by some people to change this name. Because it is not good to naming for a muslim child as Muhammed Subhan. We would like to know the answer for this uestion from your end. PLease try to give the reply as soon as possible. Thanks in advance. 1684 views Q. What is the meaning and spelling of Ariz Rahman? 4245 views Q. My name is Md. Musa Elahi. Is it right? 2758 views Q. can i name my daughter azeemah wht is the meaning? 1800 views Q. Keeping Name Mateen 3446 views Q. can i name my daughter afifa wht is it meaning? 2443 views Q. Meaning of Name 2402 views Q. Is it Haram, Makrouh, or permissible to name my son as Michelle or daughter as Suzzane? 4208 views
answer: Miscellaneous >> Islamic Names Question ID: 58020 Country: India Title: میرا نام ذبیح الحق ہے،بیٹے کے لیے کوئی اسلامی نامع معنی بتائیں، نیز لفط ”حق“ کے ساتھ۔ لڑکی کے لیے بھی کوئی اسلامی نام بتائیں۔ Question: میرا نام ذبیح الحق ہے،بیٹے کے لیے کوئی اسلامی نامع معنی بتائیں، نیز لفط ”حق“ کے ساتھ۔ لڑکی کے لیے بھی کوئی اسلامی نام بتائیں۔ Answer ID: 58020 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! Fatwa ID: 280-245/Sn=5/1436-U بیٹے کے لیے عبدالحق (اللہ کا بندہ) نور الحق (حق کی روشنی) معین الحق (حق بات کی مدد کرنے والا) اور لڑکی کے لیے ”أَمَةُ الحق (اللہ کی بندی) ”عطیہ حق“ یا مذکّرة حق میں سے کوئی نام رکھ سکتے ہیں۔ Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
